newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK APRIL CPI INFLATION TO BE RELEASED ON THURSDAY.
newsitem.headline: GREEK APRIL CPI INFLATION TO BE RELEASED ON THURSDAY.

text.p: Greece's April consumer price inflation figure will be released on Thursday, May 8, an official at the National Statistics Service (NSS) told Reuters.
Greek CPI inflation stood at 6.0 percent year-on-year in April.

The mean inflation forecast will be 5.7 percent year-on-year in April according to an informal Reuters poll conducted in early April. Forecasts ranged from 6.0 percent to 5.5 percent. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
